# When turns were deleted

This is read with `TURN.md`, not in place of it.

The briefing says which turns are gone. Everything they recorded has left with them: state, perceptions, memories, beats, your records, notes.

1. Do not refer to what was deleted. It did not happen.
2. Check the horizon and the scene. They are as they were before those turns.
3. If the player deleted in order to redo a moment, take the new message on its own terms.
